pk.context: 140 mg subcutaneous, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: clear, pale yellow solution in a prefilled single-dose pen

clues.kinetics: Absolute bioavailability after subcutaneous dosing is about 72%. Clearance runs through saturable binding to its target at low concentrations and a non-saturable proteolytic pathway at higher ones.
clues.substance: Made in genetically engineered Chinese hamster ovary cells, at about 144 kDa, and supplied as a sterile, preservative-free solution.
clues.product: Approved under BLA 125522 as 140 mg/mL prefilled pens, autoinjectors and syringes, dosed every 2 weeks or as 420 mg monthly.
clues.safety: No boxed warning. Contraindicated after serious hypersensitivity to it or its excipients, including angioedema; myalgia is the most common reaction leading to stopping treatment.
clues.indication: Reducing major cardiovascular events in adults at increased risk, and lowering LDL cholesterol in hypercholesterolemia, including familial forms from age 10.
clues.mechanism: Binds PCSK9 and prevents it from binding LDL receptors, so more receptors remain to clear LDL from the blood.

tell: An effective half-life of 11 to 17 days and a monthly 420 mg option set this PCSK9-directed antibody apart.

evidence.pk.tmaxH: median peak serum concentrations were attained in 3 to 4 days
evidence.pk.halfLifeH: REPATHA was estimated to have an effective half-life of 11 to 17 days
evidence.pk.cmax: Administration of the 140 mg dose in healthy volunteers resulted in a C max mean of 18.6 µg/mL
evidence.pill: clear to opalescent, colorless to pale yellow solution available as follows: 140 mg/mL solution in a prefilled single-dose pen
biologic: Evolocumab is a human monoclonal immunoglobulin G2 (IgG2)
Evolocumab has an approximate molecular weight (MW) of 144 kDa
clues.kinetics: At low concentrations, the elimination is predominately through saturable binding to target (PCSK9), while at higher concentrations the elimination of REPATHA is largely through a non-saturable proteolytic pathway
clues.substance: produced in genetically engineered mammalian (Chinese hamster ovary) cells
Evolocumab has an approximate molecular weight (MW) of 144 kDa
REPATHA is a sterile, preservative-free, clear to opalescent, colorless to pale yellow solution
clues.product: 140 mg/mL solution in a prefilled single-dose pen
The recommended dosage of REPATHA is either 140 mg every 2 weeks OR 420 mg once monthly administered subcutaneously
clues.safety: Serious hypersensitivity reactions including angioedema have occurred
REPATHA is contraindicated in patients with a history of a serious hypersensitivity reaction to evolocumab or any of the excipients in REPATHA
The most common adverse reaction that led to REPATHA treatment discontinuation and occurred at a rate greater than placebo was myalgia
clues.indication: To reduce the risk of major adverse cardiovascular (CV) events
adults and pediatric patients aged 10 years and older with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH)
clues.mechanism: By inhibiting the binding of PCSK9 to LDLR, evolocumab increases the number of LDLRs available to clear LDL from the blood
